title: New page: /nicotine-pouch-side-effects for "nicotine pouches side effects" (4,400 a month, LOW competition)
body:
URL: /nicotine-pouch-side-effects
Cluster: nicotine pouches side effects
Type: new-content
Source: Keyword Planner US 2026-11-23, GSC 2026-10-24..2026-11-20, inventory 2026-11-23

## Evidence
- Keyword Planner US (monthly): "nicotine pouches side effects" 4,400 (LOW competition, bids up to $4.25), "zyn side effects" 3,600 (LOW). Close variants share volume, read as one cluster.
- Inventory: /are-zyns-bad-for-you targets safety ("are zyns bad for you"), /zyn-withdrawal targets quitting symptoms, /quit-zyn the quit plan. None targets the "side effects while using" intent (mouth irritation, hiccups, nausea, heart rate, sleep).
- Fit: pouch users are the fast-growing priority audience (profile topic 2). Medical risk +2, so every claim needs FDA, CDC, NCI or Truth Initiative sources.

## Recommended action
Create a side-effects page: common (mouth and gum irritation, hiccups, nausea, headache, racing heart), when to talk to a clinician, and what to do next. Link to /are-zyns-bad-for-you (do not duplicate it; BLO-48 adds the hiccups section there, so link to it for that part), /zyn-withdrawal and /quit-zyn, and back from those pages. Do not claim Blou treats symptoms.

## Next skill
seo-content-brief

## Done when
Page live with a sourced answer-first box, FAQ from the cluster, links in from 2+ pages; impressions appear for "nicotine pouches side effects" within 4 weeks.

title: Refresh /tools/pack-year-calculator for "pack year calculator" (3,600 a month, 794 impressions, position 50)
body:
URL: /tools/pack-year-calculator
Cluster: pack year calculator
Type: refresh
Source: Keyword Planner US 2026-11-23, GSC 2026-10-24..2026-11-20

## Evidence
- GSC: 794 impressions (prev 250, up 3x), 0 clicks, average position 50.5. Top queries: "pack year calculator" (46 impr, pos 40), "pack years", "how to work out pack years", "pack year history calculator", all at positions 36 to 75.
- Keyword Planner US: "pack year calculator" 3,600 and "pack per year calculator" 3,600 (LOW competition).
- The earlier suppression window ended 2026-11-18. Demand is rising and the page does not rank on page 1 or 2 yet.

## Recommended action
Add an answer-first block with the formula (packs per day x years smoked) and a worked example, a short section on what pack years are used for (clinical history, lung cancer screening eligibility, sourced to CDC, NCI or the USPSTF), and a FAQ from the top queries. Keep the calculator above the fold. Link in from /guides and from the smoking-history pages. Risk note: the page is unranked, so a title and meta change is low risk. No medical advice beyond sourced facts.

## Next skill
seo-content-brief

## Done when
Position for "pack year calculator" under 20 within 6 weeks; clicks above 0.

title: New page: /is-vaping-worse-than-smoking for "is vaping worse than smoking" (14,800 a month, LOW competition)
body:
URL: /is-vaping-worse-than-smoking
Cluster: is vaping worse than smoking
Type: new-content
Source: Keyword Planner US 2026-11-23, inventory 2026-11-23

## Evidence
- Keyword Planner US (monthly): "is vaping worse than smoking" 14,800 (LOW competition), "is vaping worse than cigarettes" 8,100, "is vaping worse than smoking cigarettes" 3,600.
- Inventory: no page targets this comparison. /vaping-and-smoking-together, /quit-vaping and /vape-withdrawal-symptoms cover other intents.
- Fit: vapers weighing whether to quit; good path to /quit-vaping and the app. Medical risk +2 and the profile says e-cigarettes are not recommended as a quit method, so state the public-health position neutrally.

## Recommended action
Write a neutral, sourced comparison (CDC, NCI, FDA, NHS, WHO): known risks of each, what is still uncertain, and that quitting nicotine entirely is the goal. No claim that vaping is safe or a recommended quit aid. Link to /quit-vaping, /quit-vaping-timeline and /vaping-and-smoking-together. Held in Backlog until BLO-61 (popcorn lung) is written so the two pages share consistent sourcing.

## Next skill
seo-content-brief

## Done when
Page live with sourced, neutral answer box and links in from 3+ vaping pages; impressions for the cluster within 4 weeks.
